text:
maria_infra: Heads up — preflighting a new GPU nodepool in us-east4. Autoscaler spins nodes but GPU pods stay Pending. Seeing CNI assignment failures and image pulls failing. Anyone seen this combo?

sam_sre: Any cluster events or pod describe output?

maria_infra: kubectl describe pod -> "failed to assign network (CNI)". Node shows calico not applying routes. Also saw "no IPs available in pod CIDR" on one node. Autoscaler created the node but pods stuck.

priya_eng: Could be MTU mismatch between overlay and VPC (we had that with VPNs). What are calico/cluster MTU values?

maria_infra: cluster-cidr=10.0.0.0/14, calico MTU currently 1500 on new nodes but we run lowered MTU (1440) elsewhere. I think new node image defaults to 1500 which breaks encapsulation. Also separately, new nodes can't egress to registry because Cloud NAT ephemeral IP pool is almost exhausted.

dmitri_platform: Two issues then: (1) CNI MTU mismatch -> packet drops and CNI fails to program, (2) egress NAT IP shortage -> image pull timeouts. For MTU: set Calico FELIX configuration + adjust kubelet --network-plugin-mtu to 1440 or set the CNI tunnel MTU explicitly. For egress: either add NAT IPs or use regional artifact registry with VPC peering.

sam_sre: Also confirm GPU device plugin status. If node comes up but nvidia plugin isn't ready, autoscaler may think node=Ready but pods still Pending. What do nvidia-device-plugin logs show?

maria_infra: device-plugin logs: "failed to discover devices: no such file or directory". Turns out our image doesn't include the NVIDIA kernel modules/drivers (we use a custom COS build). So device plugin can't bind.

priya_eng: Ok, actionable plan: fix image/driver, fix CNI MTU, ensure egress. Suggest creating a tainted nodepool for GPUs with startup script that installs drivers and pre-pulls images, plus Calico MTU baked into node config.

maria_infra: Proposed nodepool YAML (short):
```
minSize: 0
maxSize: 20
machineType: a2-highgpu-1g
accelerators: type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1
taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule
labels: gpu_pool=preemptible
startupScript: "install drivers; prepull images; set MTU=1440"
```
Keep min=0 to save cost but warm 2 nodes later.

dmitri_platform: Cluster-autoscaler flags to change: --max-node-provision-time=15m (default too short for driver install), --expander=least-waste, --balance-similar-node-groups. Also enable --scale-up-from-zero. Consider pre-warm pool of 1-2 nodes so critical jobs don't wait on driver boot.

sam_sre: And set kubelet flag --network-plugin-mtu=1440 on that pool so kubelet/CNI agree. For calico, update configmap: FELIX_IPINIPMTU or CALICO_IPV4POOL_MTU depending on setup.

maria_infra: I'll open a quota request for A100/H100 (we may want h100 later). Also requesting +5 Cloud NAT IPs for us-east4 — current ephemeral pool at 92% usage.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026 (quota request: h100 + 5 NAT IPs). ETA: 48h.

priya_eng: Small suggestion: add podTopologySpreadConstraint or preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution anti-affinity across zones to avoid all GPU pods landing in same AZ when autoscaler behaves oddly. Also add a readiness gate on the pod to wait for nvidia-device-plugin readiness.

maria_infra: Good call. I'll add topologySpread and readinessGate. Plan of action: 1) create tainted GPU nodepool with correct image + startup script + kubelet MTU, 2) apply calico MTU configmap, 3) pre-pull images and drivers, 4) adjust autoscaler flags and create 2-node warm pool, 5) monitor Pending pods and node conditions.

sam_sre: I can run the smoke job once the pool is up. Also happy to help tune CA flags.

dmitri_platform: I'll coordinate quota request and NAT IP allocation. If quota delayed, fallback: use a smaller A10G pool temporarily.

maria_infra: Thanks all — doing the PR for nodepool config now. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
